title_en: Little girl, I will buy you
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. 'Дуњата цреша не бива' is a proverb-like image (quince cannot turn into cherry); my reading is that it means she will not be changed by gifts.

audio.who: Блага Видец, Благој Петров - Караѓуле, Васка Илиева, Кочо Петровски

dad, hey, dad,
